title: Travel Types — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: A kind of trip, such as a business meeting or training.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: WageType
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Wage Type master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The wagetype travel would be paid through.

Why it matters. Not read at present: payroll has no travel calculation, so nothing is paid through it.
